supersession_reason: The unpublished predecessor write contained manual transcription errors in the b4/b8 frontier arrays. No role-local LATEST pointer was moved to it. This v2 records the computed arrays exactly.

source_basis.predecessor_source_reuse: Pure computational continuation of the role-local exact-curtailment, fresh-audit, rho=.20 and synchronous-batch wall model; no new external empirical claim introduced.

tested_model.terminal_rule: commit iff W_r>=k with exact deterministic curtailment
tested_model.batch_semantics: candidate stages serial; b paired observations launched synchronously within a stage; launched batch paid in full; stage wall cost ceil(N_stage/b); false commit terminates stream

global_certificate_method.enumeration: All 246729 admissible length-20 action-count vectors were evaluated at every batch size. Exchange sorting by increasing p1/(1-p0) gives each multiset's exact maximum attainable worst-position q=.60 true-commit power.
global_certificate_method.order_independent_necessary_bound: For each action, compute the exact null conditional-survival stage-round PMF by mixing its curtailed discordant-sign stopping-count law with the NegativeBinomial waiting law at rho=.20. Convolve all 20 conditional-survival stage PMFs. With S=no-false-commit probability, assign every false-commit path zero wall cost, producing optimistic CDF (1-S)+S F_surv. Its q95 is an order-independent lower bound on every exact ordered policy's q95.
global_certificate_method.exact_order_readout: At every optimistic power breakpoint, exact-read the all-null stopped wall-cost distribution. When exchange order missed the optimistic budget, solve a finite count-state DP over all target-power-preserving orderings. At fixed B, reject-path CDF contribution depends only on the prefix multiset and next action because survival-PMF multiplication is commutative; therefore the DP is exact over all such orderings.
global_certificate_method.numerics: float64 finite binomial/negative-binomial recursions and convolutions. Stage-round support maxima 1200/600/300/200 for b=4/8/16/32 left <=1.2e-16 residual tail in normalization checks, beyond all reported q95 breakpoints.

results: The previous surrogate-based wall screen is now replaced by a global exact certificate inside the tested finite action class for b=4,8,16,32.
No unscreened admissible multiset improves any certified q95 wall-round frontier point. The full exact frontier has 46 breakpoints at b4, 46 at b8, 39 at b16 and 36 at b32.

Power-preserving order is a genuine cost control variable: non-exchange orders are required to attain global razor points at b4=413 and 750, b8=206 and b16=181. Other optimistic razor points are provably unattainable because the exact maximal CDF remains below .95.
At b32 the optimistic 0.053395984646347566 level at B=115 disappears from the exact frontier; power 0.053465547907689266 is feasible at q95=116 and dominates it there.
rejected_or_narrowed_generalizations: Rejected within the finite tested model: batching may hide a pair-count-suboptimal multiset outside the prior surrogate screen that materially improves wall q95.
Rejected: exchange-maximin ordering is always cost-optimal among orders preserving the same worst-position power.

Narrowed: no certificate yet for variable rollout latency, stragglers, asynchronous refill/cancel, cross-candidate concurrency, discordant depths outside {10,20,30,50}, stochastic deepening, multiple good candidates, q_good other than .60, or reused adaptive audit data.
